questions.questionHtml:
If 6tanA = 5, find the value of ( 
sin( A + B ) + sin ( A - B )_________cos( A + B ) + cos( A - B )
 + 1). 

यदि 6tanA = 5 है, तो (
sin( A + B ) + sin ( A - B )_________cos( A + B ) + cos( A - B )
+ 1) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.solution:
Given,

6tanA = 5

tanA = 5/6

We know that,

sin(A + B) + sin(A - B)= 2sinAcosB

cos(A + B) + cos (A - B) = 2cosAcosB

Now,

(2sinAcosB/2cosAcosB) + 1

= tanA + 1

= (5/6) + 1 = 11/6

questions.question: If sec a = X and cosec a = Y, then X 2 + Y 2 = ? यदि sec a = X और cosec a = Y है, तो X 2 + Y 2 =?
questions.questionHtml:
If sec a = X and cosec a = Y, then X2 + Y2 = ?

यदि sec a = X और cosec a = Y है, तो X2 + Y2=?
questions.solution:
Given: seca = X and coseca = Y

X2 + Y2 = sec2a + cosec2a

= {1}/{cos2a} + {1}/{sin2a}

= {sin2a + cos2a}/{sin2a×cos2a}

We know that cos2a + sin2a = 1

So, X2 + Y2 = {1}/{sin2a×cos2a} = cosec2a×sec2a = X2Y2

=7 sin2 A + 7 cos2 A + 2 cos2 A

= 7 + 2 cos2A

The minimum value of cos A = -1, here square of cosA is given and we know that the value of any square function lies between 0 and 1 and therefore, the minimum value of cos2A = 0.

So, 7 + 0 = 7

questions.question: If p = Sin A + Cos A and q = Sin A - Cos A, then what is the value of p 2 - 1 _________ 1 - q 2 यदि p = Sin A + Cos A और q = Sin A - Cos A है, तो p 2 - 1/1 - q 2 का मान क्या है?
questions.questionHtml:
If p = Sin A + Cos A and q = Sin A - Cos A, then what is the value of 
p2 - 1_________1 - q2

यदि p = Sin A + Cos A और q = Sin A - Cos A है, तो p2 - 1/1 - q2 का मान क्या है?
questions.solution:
p = SinA + CosA (Given)

p2 = (SinA + CosA)2 = Sin2A + Cos2A + 2SinACosA = 1 + Sin2A

q = SinA - CosA

q2 = (SinA - CosA)2 = Sin2A + Cos2A - 2SinACosA = 1 - Sin2A

Now the value of expression = (p2 - 1)/(1 - q2) = (1 + Sin2A - 1)/(1 - 1 + Sin2A)

=> Sin2A/Sin2A = 1
